grains.RAW.PORTFOLIOS: one row per financing portfolio (one financing product booked in one Malaysian city)
grains.RAW.PORTFOLIO_DAILY: one row per portfolio per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CONTRACT_DOCUMENTS: one row per portfolio (contract file document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.escalation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(a documentation exception on the portfolio is escalated to the Shariah committee in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day bank-wide exception-volume FORECAST; document rejection rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.REVIEW_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic exception-handling SOPs (one per financing product and exception reason)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SHARIAH_REVIEW_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SHARIAH_REVIEW_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, portfolio, exception-reason and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (portfolios, daily documentation exceptions, escalations by portfolio, escalation risk, review events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_REVIEWS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_EXCEPTION_ALERT logs new EXCEPTION review results to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
